textKey.failure: Case-only key change stopped the form: grid order must change when rows or columns change
textKey.correction: Compare identity strings with sk char codes; case/accent/@ saved keys and old-handle rejection pass in both modes

voiceover.failure: Checkbox activation spoke the unrelated first text editor instead of the checked state
voiceover.correction: Direct native checkbox click and confirmed feedback retained only across a same-cell reveal

competingInputActors.failure: External AX press competed with VoiceOver automatic reveal; successful macOS transport did not deliver the original handler
competingInputActors.resolution: The canonical VoiceOver driver navigates to and activates the original inspection button through VoiceOver, then requires one native handler call, application receipt and independently read stored data. Provider single-flight behavior is unchanged.

transientFocusReceipt.failure: Keyboard focus was confirmed, then VoiceOver automatic reveal replaced the latest AXHelp before the assertion read it
transientFocusReceipt.resolution: Observe the receipt transition for this focus request and require actual AXFocused, without replaying input or changing provider behavior

invalidScrollbarFixture.failure: The first fixture used invalid always enum; no visible bars were exercised
invalidScrollbarFixture.correction: Use visible enum and require OBJECT GET SCROLLBAR Boolean proof before action checks

classicCommands.scope: Candidate commands in interpreted and compiled desktop engine processes. No grid, accessibility UI or VoiceOver coverage claim.

fable5.1.verdict: No blocking defect found; parent area and generated metadata keep host changes minimal

fable5.1.limits: Review did not inspect every native diff line or establish additional layouts/runtime coverage
